meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 gtars 处理基因组区间数据：查找重叠区域、生成覆盖度轨道、把区间转成机器学习用的 token、管理参考序列、拆分和评分片段等。它既支持 Python 代码也支持命令行操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 BED 文件、检测基因组区间重叠、生成覆盖度轨道等基因组分析任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 gtars 找出这两个 BED 文件的重叠区域。
say.note: 会构建 IGD 索引并返回重叠区间。

say.text: 用 gtars 把这段 ATAC-seq 片段生成 BigWig 覆盖度轨道。
say.note: 调用 uniwig 生成覆盖度文件。

say.text: 给这些训练区域做 tokenization，用 TreeTokenizer。

howto.what_en: With gtars installed, Claude can process genomic interval data: detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks, convert regions into tokens for ML, manage reference sequences, and split/score fragments. It supports both Python API and CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to work with BED files, detect overlaps between genomic regions, generate coverage tracks, or perform other genomic interval tasks such as ML preprocessing or fragment analysis.

say_en.text: Use gtars to find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Builds an IGD index and returns overlaps.

say_en.text: Use gtars to generate a BigWig coverage track from these ATAC-seq fragments.
say_en.note: Calls uniwig to produce the coverage file.

say_en.text: Tokenize these training regions using TreeTokenizer.
